sonnet.problem: The right answer "It never ends" has a different form from the two wrong answers ("When you reach home", "When you grow old"). It is the only answer not shaped like "When…", so it stands out and doesn't fit the "When does that watch end?" question in the same way. A baker can pick it from the wording alone.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike.
